name: session-wrap
description: Wrap up a Claude Code desktop session: tidy docs with neat-freak, commit and push, open a PR, wait for CI (fixing failures), and merge it into main, clean up stale branches and worktrees, then archive the session. Optionally runs code-review sub-sessions before merging. Activates only when the user's message contains the exact word session-wrap (hyphenation and case don't matter).
